# Limits (say kindly when a wish is outside them, offer the closest thing)

- **Look:** stylised 3D comic people from primitives — mitten hands (no separate fingers), face expressions without lip-sync, hijab/clothes without cloth simulation. No realistic people, no real persons or celebrities, no brand logos or franchise characters.
- **Action:** people stand, sit, point, cover their face, stomp, reach, hold things, react, walk in place / move by keyframes — no running choreography, fights, dancing, sports, swimming, climbing, hugging, crowds (≤ 3 people per shot reads best).
- **Places:** interiors, simple street / park exteriors and abstract comic stages. Complex architecture, vehicles in motion, animals, water, fire beyond a stylised flame, weather beyond the rain-cloud item are made as simple shapes or implied by graphics and sound.
- **Text:** short comic lettering only (1–3 words per hit) plus caption boxes; no subtitles of the whole VO (PANELVERSE is a picture-first style); Indonesian lettering by default.
- **Format:** 9:16 1080×1920 @ 60 fps (preview 540×960 @ 30). Landscape is not part of this version.
- **Sound:** the buyer's VO + synthesised effects; no music with vocals, no added voices, no TTS unless the buyer approves it.
- **Platform:** tested on macOS Apple Silicon with Node 24; Node ≥ 22.13 required.
